mapper.sql: c.*, COALESCE(( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM messages m_unread WHERE m_unread.conversation_id = c.id AND m_unread.read_at IS NULL ), 0) AS unread_count, ( SELECT m_preview.content FROM messages m_preview WHERE m_preview.conversation_id = c.id ORDER BY m_preview.created_at DESC, m_preview.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS last_message_preview, ( SELECT MAX(m_read.read_at) FROM messages m_read WHERE m_read.conversation_id = c.id ) AS last_read_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO conversations (type, title, owner_id, peer_user_id, related_type, related_id, replyable, last_message_at, created_at) VALUES (#{type}, #{title}, #{ownerId}, #{peerUserId}, #{relatedType}, #{relatedId}, #{replyable}, #{lastMessageAt}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM conversations WHERE owner_id = #{ownerId}

SELECT
FROM conversations c WHERE c.owner_id = #{ownerId} AND c.peer_user_id = #{peerUserId} AND c.type = 'PRIVATE' AND c.replyable = 1 ORDER BY c.id ASC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE conversations SET type = #{type}, title = #{title}, owner_id = #{ownerId}, peer_user_id = #{peerUserId}, related_type = #{relatedType}, related_id = #{relatedId}, replyable = #{replyable}, last_message_at = #{lastMessageAt}, created_at = #{createdAt} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE conversations SET peer_user_id = #{peerUserId}, last_message_at = GREATEST(COALESCE(last_message_at, #{lastMessageAt}), #{lastMessageAt}) WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT c.* FROM conversations c WHERE c.owner_id = #{ownerId} AND c.peer_user_id = #{peerUserId} AND c.type = 'PRIVATE' AND c.replyable = 1 LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
